title: Answer MCP elicitation forms and tool dialogs in the Claude pane
notes: Claude Code renders a server's form or dialog. SDK: onElicitation (sdk.d.ts:1803), onUserDialog (1817), supportedDialogKinds (1839). Pane: not wired; what happens to an elicitation now is unverified. Size M.

comments.body: PR #116: onElicitation wired (form walked a field at a time, URL opened and accepted, decline on every step). onUserDialog left undeclared: only documented kind refusal_fallback_prompt has no published payload/result shape (sdk.d.ts:1817-1839, 10280-10307); undeclared means CLI never emits, keeps classic fallback. Not hand-checked: needs an MCP server that elicits.
Shipped in PR #116: the ask box answers an MCP server's forms and sign-in links (elicitation). Version 2.26.0.
